notifications.list.description: Page through the caller's side's notifications: the keyword matches title and content; filter by type, priority, target and published state. Requires notification.notifications.read.
notifications.get.description: Get a notification with its delivery targets. Requires notification.notifications.read.
notifications.create.description: Create a notification draft, optionally publishing it at once: role, department and user targets need at least one ID, and departments exist only on the tenant side. Requires notification.notifications.create, plus notification.notifications.publish to publish at once.
notifications.update.description: Replace a notification draft, including its targets; published notifications cannot be changed. Requires notification.notifications.update.
notifications.delete.description: Delete notifications in bulk; published ones also leave their recipients' inboxes. Requires notification.notifications.delete.
notifications.publish.description: Publish a draft: resolve the active recipients of the caller's side from its targets, write their inbox entries and push them in real time after commit; a notification is published only once. Requires notification.notifications.publish.
notifications.remind.description: Remind: push a published notification again to recipients who have not read it, or not confirmed it when confirmation is required. Requires notification.notifications.publish.
notifications.read_stats.description: Read statistics: recipients, read, unread and confirmed counts. Requires notification.notifications.read.
notifications.recipients.description: Page through the recipients of a published notification with their read and confirmation state; optionally only unread or unconfirmed ones. Requires notification.notifications.read.
inbox.list.description: Page through your own inbox on the current side (published and within their visibility window): the keyword matches title and content; filter by read state and type or show only pending items. Any signed-in user.
inbox.banners.description: Your unread banner notifications, shown at the top of the page. Any signed-in user.
inbox.popups.description: Your popup notifications not shown yet; each pops up once after sign-in. Any signed-in user.
inbox.mandatory.description: Your unread mandatory notifications; pages are blocked until they are read. Any signed-in user.
inbox.mark_read.description: Mark entries of your own inbox as read. Any signed-in user.
inbox.mark_all_read.description: Mark every visible unread entry of your inbox on the current side as read. Any signed-in user.
inbox.confirm.description: Confirm a notification in your inbox that asks for confirmation; it is marked read too. Any signed-in user.
inbox.mark_popup_shown.description: Record that one of your popup notifications has been shown so it does not pop up again. Any signed-in user.
inbox.delete.description: Delete entries from your own inbox; the notifications themselves are unaffected. Any signed-in user.
notification.notification.published: Notification {id} is already published and cannot be changed or published again.
notification.notification.not_published: Notification {id} has not been published yet.
notification.target.required: Choose at least one target when the delivery target is {targetType}.
notification.target.department_platform: The platform side has no departments; notifications cannot target departments there.
notification.window.invalid: The expiry must be later than the start.
notification.recipients.none: The delivery targets resolve to no active recipients.
notification.notification.publish_denied: Publishing right away requires the publish permission.
notification.recipients.source_missing: This deployment cannot resolve recipients by {targetType}.
